capability_profile.assurance: numerical binary64 exactness checks; not validated arithmetic
capability_profile.supported_case: two-stage scalar system with two bounded non-singleton interval controls; scalar interval invariants/guards; deterministic exactly representable affine resets; scalar linear terminal objective; complete family checked by the exact linear H verifier

environment.timing_scope: One end-to-end call includes fixture/provider setup, complete path relation assembly, LP execution, candidate-face construction, and verification of all allowed path families. Serialization, build, and rendering are excluded.

warmup_policy.baseline: One excluded 10-call batch followed by seven measured 20-call batches
warmup_policy.capacity: Two excluded calls per path-count fixture, followed by seven measured batches of 10 calls

environment.workspace_reuse: none; fresh fixture, provider and workspace per call

evidence_limits: One host, one Release configuration, and one fixed analytic two-stage fixture.
The controls are independent and bounded; no higher-dimensional parameter polytope is measured.
Provider invocation records use a narrower synchronous wall/CPU interval; process CPU sums all process threads, includes clock sampling, and may include unrelated work.
Provider memory use is unmeasured; the HiGHS adapter refuses finite memory requests rather than claiming enforcement.
No comparator, speedup, source-mapped bottleneck, application-scale result, or scalability claim.
Binary64 checks are numerical assurance and do not establish validated arithmetic.
Per-operation CPU measures only the synchronous composing thread and excludes CPU consumed by helper threads.
evidence_scope: 140 completed baseline calls; optional capacity sweep adds 350 full public hybrid portfolio calls across 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 tied paths, with every path solved and every candidate family verified by ExactLinearHHybridFamilyVerifier

measurement.comparison: one backend and one fixed fixture; descriptive only, no comparator or speedup claim

operation_thread_cpu.scope: CPU consumed by the synchronous composing thread during each relation operation

process_cpu.attribution: process-scoped, not provider-only; unrelated concurrent process work may contribute
process_cpu.scope: process CPU accumulated across all threads during workspace creation and branch execution

provider_invocation.scope: synchronous provider invocation; process CPU includes clock sampling and may include helper threads or unrelated concurrent process work

solver_capacity_profile.claim_limit: single scalar, two-stage fixture on one host; descriptive capacity evidence only, not a general scalability or solver limit claim
solver_capacity_profile.fixture: two-stage scalar fixed-control model with N tied mode paths; each guard admits the common optimum u0=0
solver_capacity_profile.timing_scope: per-call setup, path composition, HiGHS solve of every path, candidate-family construction, and ExactLinearHHybridFamilyVerifier coverage of every tied path
